native_qualification.mips_function_execution: Locked Unicorn dev dependency executes original growth fixtures on both native hosts; this does not qualify a full PS1 runtime or retail playthrough.

modified_builds.scope: Fixed original function entries and program extents; larger bodies/helpers/data require reviewed loaded zero reserves. Resources can use reviewed file relocation and first-data-track growth. An exact assembly baseline precedes every build.
modified_builds.owned_data_bss_or_helpers: Supported only within reviewed loaded reserves, preserving original function entries and function-pointer identity.

growth_validation.inputs: Original fixtures compiled with both pinned GCC versions
growth_validation.execution: Linked MIPS code executes in Unicorn, including larger bodies, helper calls, initialized globals, zero storage and returned function pointers across different high-half addresses.

archive_storage.loader_length_fields: 2 or 4 bytes, little or big endian
archive_storage.loader_fixups: Unchanged original fixups are restored to unrelocated storage; explicit reviewed additive bases permit inverse R_MIPS_32/R_MIPS_26 authoring at existing sites.
archive_storage.qualification: Original ISO and Mode 2 raw fixtures; two exclusive compressed overlays with C++ growth.

chd.scope: Standalone/combined CHD v5 source/resource builds; reviewed first-track growth can retime validated ordinary interleaved audio Q with CHT2 track geometry.
chd.audio_and_subcode: PCM, P and R-W remain unchanged. Validated Q absolute/sector timestamps and CRCs are updated; absent Q stays absent. Unknown/protected packets remain guarded.
chd.metadata: Original metadata tags, flags, ordering and other payloads retained; reviewed growth changes first-track FRAMES while retaining audio/pregaps.
chd.output_codec: Standard raw-deflate zlib, with raw hunks for incompressible content; may be larger than the original.
chd.verification: Every output decoded hunk compared to intended original/patched/inserted frames before publication; hunk/map CRC16, raw/metadata SHA-1, aggregate decoded SHA-256 and expected track geometry verified.

resources.scope: Bounded resource replacement, reviewed first-track growth and HBD member edits for standalone/combined ISO/raw/CUE/supported CHD projects.
resources.loader_fields: Reviewed original LBA/size/sectors scalar fields; no inferred game tables.
resources.copied_helper_upgrade: decompnet psx upgrade PATH preserves sources/assets and backs up replaced helpers.
